programme.title: Schindler's List
programme.desc: Steven Spielberg and Liam Neeson create a poignant and powerful film. After witnessing his Jewish workers' persecution by the Nazis, a German businessman decides to help them.

programme.title: The Dilemma

programme.title: Spud

programme.title: The Little Rascals

programme.title: Midway

programme.title: The Wish Of Fairy Fish
programme.desc: An adventure-filled fairy tale fantasy. If you go fishing, be prepared to draw the fish of your dreams, the magical Pike, which can grant any three wishes.

programme.title: Upon The Magic Roads

programme.title: Shrek Forever After
programme.desc: Shrek makes a deal with Rumpelstiltskin to get back his ferocious self. But he gets sent to an alternate version of Far Far Away instead.

programme.title: The Naked Gun 2: The Smell Of Fear
programme.desc: The second instalment in the belly laughs-inducing police detective classic parody. Leslie Nielsen's Lt. Frank Drebin discovers a plot to kidnap a solar energy scientist.

programme.title: Wicked

programme.title: Snake Eyes: G.I. Joe Origins

programme.title: Bridesmaids

programme.title: Wedding Crashers
programme.desc: Owen Wilson and Vince Vaughn run this crazy comedy. A pair of friends and womanisers crash weddings to meet women. Things get complicated when one of them falls for a bridesmaid.

programme.title: The Day We Didn't Meet
programme.desc: A great South African film. Alex and Sam reconnect after a chance encounter. They imagine a fantasy life together and abandon all their responsibilities. However, reality sets in.

programme.title: Girl You Know It's True

programme.title: Spud 2: The Madness Continues

programme.title: Kipchoge: The Last Milestone

programme.desc: Martin Lawrence stars in this comedy from the director of The Best Man. A successful talk show host leaves Los Angeles to reunite with his family in the Deep South.
